product.title: Decision Room Simulator
product.summary: Two experts, the same data, opposite conclusions — and both are 90% confident.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students take a trade-deadline or draft-day scenario in which two models reach opposite conclusions from the same injury data while both reporting high confidence. Across five phases they classify each model's claims and pick a posture — push, hold, hybrid or reframe — that moves sensitivity, rigidity and confidence.

facilitation.notes: One experience in two builds: a browser build and a parallel Apps Script build whose sheet names and vocabulary match it closely.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Both builds complete and the browser build is publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.

provenance.evidence: 301-M4-L2/index.html: 'Both models still show 90%+ confidence despite using the same injury data to reach opposite conclusions' — 'the clearest sign that the disagreement is philosophical, not analytical'.
